title: Theme
description: Appearance tokens, consumed by the ENGINE only. The AI never sees this. Final token list: OQ-10 (draft).

caption_preset.description: one of the engine's caption presets

motion_feel.description: maps to easing/duration scales in components

surface.description: D46 — the SHAPE of an overlay. Every token optional; omitted means the value components hardcoded before D46, so an untouched theme renders identically.

radius.description: corner radius scale; the engine owns the pixels

fill.description: panel background: opaque bg, bg at ~90%, or nothing

accent_rule.description: where the accent bar sits. No default on purpose: omitted keeps each component's own choice (FactCard draws it on top, the card template on the left).

motion.description: D46 — HOW an overlay arrives. Duration scaling stays in motion_feel.

entrance.description: a REQUEST, not a guarantee: a component that cannot honor it (typewriter on a chart) degrades to fade. No default on purpose: omitted keeps each component's own entrance, so an untouched theme is unchanged.

easing.description: smooth is the pre-D46 curve, bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)

per_component.description: per-catalog-name entrance override. Exceptions only — a map approaching one entry per component is the trigger for motion roles (D47).

sound.description: D48 — how a theme SOUNDS. Names cues and beds from a sound pack, the way typography names packaged fonts. Every token optional; a theme with no `sound` block produces a silent video exactly as before. The AI never sees this.

pack.description: default sound pack name; channel config source_policy.sound_pack overrides it

entrance.description: default cue for an overlay entrance. Omitted means no entrance sfx at all — silence is the default, not a fallback swoosh.

per_entrance.description: cue by the entrance kind that actually plays, after the theme's motion tokens and the component's support are resolved. A typewriter entrance wants a typing loop; a pop wants a transient.

per_component.description: per-catalog-name cue override. Exceptions only, like motion.per_component. Set "none" to silence one component.

transition.description: cue for a visual transition. Omitted (the default) means none: at a 4s hold a cue per transition is 15/minute, which is the fastest way to sound amateur.

mood_beds.description: mood -> bed name. A mood with no entry gets no music for that span, which is a legitimate choice: silence under the turn.

gain.description: the mix. Numbers, not enums, because these ARE the mix — there is no vocabulary that means '18 dB under the voice'. All three are absolute levels applied to the pack's files; the channel's source_policy trims them.

music_duck.description: bed level while a sentence is playing. Against the shipped packs (beds at -24 LUFS) this lands the bed about 18 dB under a typical narration — present, never competing.

music_lift.description: bed level in a narration gap long enough to be heard: about 8 dB under the voice, so the music is unmistakably there in the silence.

cueRef.description: a cue or bed name in the resolved sound pack, or "none" to silence
